ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Loi n° 2016-1691 du 9 décembre 2016 relative à la transparence, à la lutte contre la corruption et à la modernisation de la vie économique (Sapin II); Décret n° 2017-1094 du 12 juin 2017 relatif au registre des bénéficiaires effectifs; Code monétaire et financier, Articles L.561-1 to L.564-3; Directive (EU) 2015/849 (4th AML Directive) as transposed; Directive (EU) 2018/843 (5th AML Directive) as transposed; Arrêté du 28 février 2019 relatif au registre des bénéficiaires effectifs; INPI RNE UBO register requirements.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, legal representatives, and senior managers against: (1) French domestic PEP lists maintained by ACPR and TRACFIN; (2) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (3) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (4) OFAC SDN and Consolidated Sanctions List; (5) French Ministerial Asset Freeze Registry (Registre national des gels). Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) required for any PEP match, with senior management approval and source of wealth verification. Screening must be repeated annually and upon any change in UBO or management. TRACFIN suspicious transaction reporting obligations apply under Code monétaire et financier Article L.561-15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI - Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) / Guichet Unique (https://www.guichet-unique.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate name must be in French or a language using the Latin alphabet. Foreign-language names are permitted if accompanied by a French translation. Arabic, Cyrillic, Chinese, or other non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters. The name must not be purely descriptive of the activity. Use of the acronym 'SAS' or 'S.A.S.' is mandatory in all official documents and must follow the corporate name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Transport routier de marchandises (requires specific transport license)
TIR (requires IRU authorization and French transport ministry approval)
Commissionnaire en douane (requires customs broker license)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection by INPI, the applicant must file a written appeal (recours gracieux) with the INPI Director General within 30 days of notification. The appeal must state grounds demonstrating non-confusion with existing registered names. If rejected, a contentious appeal (recours contentieux) may be filed before the Tribunal Judiciaire de Paris within 2 months of the final administrative decision. Alternative name proposals must be submitted simultaneously. Legal counsel specializing in intellectual property and commercial law is mandatory for contentious proceedings. The name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon written request before expiration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not accepted for SAS registration or for the transport and logistics industry. A physical registered address with proof of occupancy (lease agreement, property title, or domiciliation contract with a licensed domiciliataire) is mandatory. For cross-border trucking, a physical operating base for fleet management is required under French transport regulations. Domiciliation contracts must be with a licensed provider under Article L.123-11-1 of the Code de commerce.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (85-95% probability). The French transport authority (DREAL) and customs (Douane Française) conduct unannounced physical inspections for transport license compliance, TIR Carnet holder verification, and bonded warehouse/vehicle inspection. ACPR may conduct AML/CFT on-site inspections within the first 12 months of operation. INPI and greffe may verify registered office address through cross-referencing with tax and social security databases.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), principally Articles L.210-1 to L.210-9, L.227-1 to L.227-20, R.123-1 to R.123-286, and applicable provisions concerning the Registre national des entreprises and Registre du commerce et des sociétés. The SAS must appoint a President under Article L.227-6.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI) Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises and Registre national des entreprises, with registration in the competent Registre du commerce et des sociétés maintained by the relevant commercial court registry (greffe du tribunal de commerce).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of creation of a company (formalité de création) submitted through the INPI Guichet unique, including the company formation information, articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, and supporting documents. A legal-notice publication certificate is also required.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies to an SAS; EUR 1 is legally permissible, although higher capital is commercially advisable. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years. Cash contributions are deposited with a bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations, which issues a deposit certificate. The deposit account is released after registration. In-kind contributions are generally transferred at incorporation and may require a commissaire aux apports unless a statutory exemption applies. The stated USD fee is an approximate exchange-rate equivalent of the standard commercial registration charge and excludes legal-notice publication, beneficial-owner filing, translations, professional fees, and sectoral permits.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders of [Company Name] SAS hereby resolve that: (1) the share capital of EUR [amount], divided into [number] shares of EUR [nominal value] each, is approved and subscribed as set out in the subscription schedule, with the required cash amount paid into the designated deposit account; (2) the registered office is established at [full French address]; (3) [name, identification details] is appointed President for an indefinite term, with authority to complete incorporation, banking, tax, registry, customs, transport, and licensing formalities; and (4) all acts necessary to obtain registration are approved and ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm Corporate Name, Purpose, Office, and Governance Terms
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI corporate-name search resources, competent commercial court registry, and the INPI Guichet unique portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a legally available name, define the corporate purpose to cover road freight transport, international carriage, customs and TIR-related activities, and secure a French registered office. Draft SAS articles addressing capital, transfer restrictions, decision rights, President powers, accounting year, and shareholder procedures. Obtain landlord or domiciliation consent.
required_dossiers: Registered-office lease, domiciliation agreement, or occupancy certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Revise the name, purpose, or address evidence if the registry identifies ambiguity, non-availability, unlawful activities, or inadequate domiciliation evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute Articles and Arrange Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Depository bank, French notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the articles and shareholder subscription schedule. Open a temporary capital-deposit account, transfer the required paid-up cash amount, and obtain the deposit certificate. Foreign corporate shareholders should provide legalized or apostilled corporate extracts, constitutional documents, signatory authority, and certified French translations where required.
required_dossiers: Foreign corporate documents and powers of attorney, if applicable
In-kind contribution report or waiver, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct signature, identification, beneficial-ownership, or source-of-funds deficiencies and obtain a replacement deposit certificate if the bank rejects the account opening.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A habilitated legal-announcement journal (journal d'annonces légales) in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the statutory formation notice containing the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, President details, and registration information. Pay the applicable tariff and obtain the publication certificate for upload to the INPI portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Republish a corrected notice if the journal or registry identifies an omission, inconsistent corporate data, or an incorrect department.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic company-formation filing, select SAS, complete the business activity and establishment fields, upload the signed articles, capital deposit certificate, legal-notice certificate, office evidence, President declaration, and beneficial-owner declaration, then electronically sign and pay the applicable charges. Identify the RCS activity and transport activity accurately.
required_dossiers: President declaration of non-conviction and parentage
Translation and legalization documents, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer the INPI or registry deficiency notice through the portal within the stated deadline, upload corrected documents, and request re-examination. A refusal may be challenged or resubmitted after curing the stated defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Registration and Activate Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent commercial court registry, INPI RNE, and tax administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Monitor the filing until the company receives its SIREN, SIRET, APE/NAF classification, and Kbis extract. Verify that the registered activity, President, address, and beneficial-owner data are correct. Open or convert the permanent bank account, release deposited capital, establish statutory registers, and activate accounting and tax records.
required_dossiers: Statutory share-transfer and corporate decision registers
Accounting engagement and tax registration records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction from the competent registry or INPI for clerical inaccuracies and file an amendment formalité for changes to registered information.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Road Freight Transport Capacity and Community Licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Regional prefecture transport authority: DREAL, DRIEAT Île-de-France, or DEAL in an overseas department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before operating for hire or reward, submit the undertaking's transport-registration application to the competent regional authority. Demonstrate establishment in France, professional competence, good repute, and required financial standing; appoint a transport manager holding the required professional qualification. After approval, request the European Community licence and certified copies for each vehicle.
required_dossiers: Proof of establishment and operating premises
Vehicle ownership, lease, or availability documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the DREAL, DRIEAT, or DEAL deficiency request, replace an unqualified transport manager, supplement financial evidence, or appeal an adverse decision under applicable administrative-law procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Customs, TIR, Vehicle, and Driver Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French Customs and Indirect Taxes Directorate (Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects), competent customs office, IRU/TIR issuing channel, and relevant vehicle and labour authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain an EORI number, configure customs representation and electronic customs systems, and obtain authorization to use TIR carnets through the French TIR guarantee chain and customs authorities. Ensure each vehicle has the required certified Community-licence copy, registration, insurance, technical inspection, tachograph, and roadworthiness documents. Implement driver qualification, driving-time, rest-time, posting, and social-record controls.
required_dossiers: TIR carnet authorization and guarantee-chain documents
Community licence and certified vehicle copies
Driver licences and professional qualification records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct customs or TIR application deficiencies, provide additional guarantees or records, request administrative review, and suspend affected operations until the relevant authorization is confirmed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry for Ecological Transition transport administration, implemented regionally by the competent DREAL, DRIEAT Île-de-France, or DEAL. Customs and TIR authorization is administered by the Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licence communautaire for international carriage of goods by road for hire or reward, with a certified true copy for each vehicle. The undertaking must also be registered as a road freight transport operator and satisfy establishment, professional competence, good-repute, and financial-standing requirements. TIR operations require separate customs and guarantee-chain authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, with the competent regional environmental authority (DREAL/DRIEAT/DEAL) and the prefecture
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Ordinary trucking operations are generally not subject to a standalone full EIA. A depot, workshop, fuel installation, vehicle-washing facility, or storage activity must be screened under the French ICPE nomenclature and may require declaration, registration, or prefectural authorization. Project-level environmental assessment is case-specific.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with the applicable ICPE order and prefectural requirements for wastewater, stormwater, oil separators, hazardous substances, fuel storage, VOC emissions, noise, spill prevention, and waste handling. Discharges must meet the applicable sewer-operator or environmental permit limits; hazardous and non-hazardous waste must be segregated, documented, and transferred to authorized operators, with Trackdéchets used where legally required. No single nationwide threshold applies to every trucking depot.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain municipal or prefectural fire-safety clearance where required for the premises, including emergency access, extinguishers, fire detection, fuel and hazardous-material controls, evacuation routes, and occupational-risk measures. Secure landlord, insurer, and competent authority approval for structural load, vehicle circulation, ramps, workshops, lifting equipment, electrical installations, and storage systems. Conduct required inspections through accredited bodies and comply with the French Labour Code, occupational-health service requirements, workplace risk assessment (DUERP), and applicable machinery and electrical-safety rules.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the public portal impots.gouv.fr; French customs and indirect-tax control at borders is exercised by Direction Generale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) for TIR customs and export/import formalities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a French SAS or branch registers online through the Guichet Unique des Formalites des Entreprises (formalities.entreprises.gouv.fr), obtaining the INSEE-issued SIREN/SIRET identifier; DGFiP then allocates the intra-Community VAT number (FR followed by 11 digits) to the registered establishment. Foreign suppliers without a French establishment but triggering French VAT liability must apply directly to the DGFiP (Service des Impots des Entreprises) under the non-established taxable person registration procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The SAS is by default subject to French entity-level corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Societes); it may elect pass-through income tax treatment under CGI Article 239 bis AA where the SME conditions are satisfied; a group may elect 100% consolidation (integration fiscale) under CGI Article 223 A; VAT grouping as a single taxable person may be elected under CGI Article 1693 ter; hybrid mismatch outcomes are constrained by the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive implementation in French domestic law, and France does not operate unilateral check-the-box elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA: lower exemption thresholds of EUR 91,000 for supplies of goods and EUR 36,800 for supplies of services, with upper tolerance thresholds of EUR 101,000 and EUR 42,500 respectively (2023 rules); non-established foreign suppliers generally cannot benefit from the franchise and must register from the first taxable transaction in France.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France mandates structured electronic invoicing and e-reporting under the 2021/2022 e-invoicing reform: from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-size businesses and 1 September 2027 for small and micro businesses, invoices must be issued in Factur-X, UBL or CII format through a certified Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP) or the Public Invoicing Portal (PPF). No per-transaction digital stamping applies; transaction-line data must be transmitted to DGFiP through the PPF API environment and directory systems, and platforms must maintain interoperable APIs and complete audit trails.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (i) goods physically exported outside the European Union where the customs export declaration and transport evidence demonstrate exit from EU customs territory (CGI Article 262, 1°); (ii) supply of international freight transport services to a business customer established outside France, where the B2B place-of-supply rules locate the supply outside French VAT scope (CGI Article 259 B); and (iii) intra-Community dispatches to a VAT-registered customer holding a valid intra-Community VAT number, supported by proof of movement. For TIR road transport, zero-rating is substantiated by the TIR Carnet, CMR waybill, and customs transit documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/ENS and, where applicable, TIR Carnet)
CMR Waybill (Contrat de transport international de marchandises par route)
Bill of Lading or Road Consignment Note
Proof of exit from France and EU customs territory (customs stamps or electronic clearance data)
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank payment evidence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP may audit the export substantiation file within the statutory limitation period (generally the ordinary three-year period under Article L.169 of the LPF, extended where omissions or fraudulent conduct exist). Unsupported export zero-rating triggers VAT reassessment with late-payment interest of 0.20% per month, penalties of 40% for deliberate inaccuracies and 80% for abusive or artificial arrangements under Article 1729 CGI, and potential criminal tax-fraud liability under Article 1741 CGI (up to five years' imprisonment, extended to ten years in aggravated cases). Incorrectly claimed refunds of input VAT are clawed back in full, with the burden of proof resting on the taxpayer to demonstrate the reality of the underlying export transactions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a regime of full convertibility for the euro on both current and capital accounts. Residents and French entities may freely transfer funds abroad, subject to tax declaration thresholds (e.g., €100,000 annually for capital movements) and AML compliance. Profit remittances to EU shareholders are unrestricted, with no capital controls or mandatory surrender mechanisms.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory mandatory surrender of export proceeds required in France. Exporters must file customs declarations within 30 days of shipment under TIR Carnets procedures. Conversion occurs at market rates with no fixed ratios. Tax authorities require supporting documentation for VAT and corporate tax credits; bonded transport compliance is mandatory but FX surrender is not.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasible under EU PSD2 and French regulations for digital payments, but constrained for physical trucking operations; offshore EMIs require local banking partnerships and face strict authorization and AML requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors must appear physically for corporate onboarding and KYC interviews; remote video KYC is permitted for subsequent transactions under updated French regulations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions exposure or adverse media screening failure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening certificates, source of funds affidavits, beneficial ownership declarations, and clean transaction history

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction links in beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence reports, third-party risk assessments, and proof of legitimate business purpose

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound wires via SWIFT with purpose codes such as 'CAPCON' (capital contribution) or 'TRADSET' (trade settlement). Verification requires commercial contracts, invoices, customs declarations, and beneficial ownership information. All transactions screened for AML and reported to French tax authorities.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing via SWIFT MT103 for international payments and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) under UCP 600 for trade finance. For TIR bonded trucking, disbursements to fuel suppliers or drivers use correspondent banking networks with supporting customs and tax documentation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual deposit of statutory financial statements (depot des comptes annuels) including balance sheet, profit-and-loss account and annexed notes, together with the management report where required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the greffe du tribunal de commerce, filed exclusively through the INPI Guichet Unique portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be approved by the annual shareholders' meeting within six months of the financial year-end; the RCS deposit must be filed within one month of approval. For a 31 December year-end, the long-stop filing date is 31 July of the following calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the legal representative to a fine of up to EUR 5,000; the commercial court may issue an injunction with a compulsory penalty payment (astreinte), order publication of the judgment, and after formal notice and persistent default the court may order the company's strike-off (radiation) from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary general assembly of the SAS shareholders approving the financial statements, discharging the President, and approving related-party agreements under Article L.227-6 Code de commerce (minutes retained in the corporate minute book)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not filed with any regulator; the signed minutes are kept in the company's statutory minute book at the registered office; the minutes may be required by the registry as an annex to the annual accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be convened no later than six months after the close of the financial year; minutes are filed together with the annual accounts deposit within one month of the meeting.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting within six months permits any interested party or the Public Prosecutor to apply to the President of the commercial court to order the meeting; persistent default may also support a judicial winding-up (liquidation judiciaire) petition by creditors and exposes directors to civil liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporation tax return (liasse fiscale 2065 plus 2050-series annexes; simplified 2065-SD for eligible small enterprises) and payment of the corporate income tax balance due
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP) online service via the entity's professional online tax account
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 12-month accounting period ending 31 December, the return is due on the second working day following 1 May of the following calendar year; for accounting periods ending other than 31 December, the return is due within three months of the year-end for online filers.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid tax attracts late-payment interest of 0.2% per month and a late-filing increase of 5% (accelerating to 40% where the return is not filed after formal notice); wilful non-declaration is subject to an 80% penalty and the DGFiP may issue an official assessment and tax seizure against the entity's assets.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Update or annual confirmation of the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (beneficial ownership declaration) covering natural persons holding directly or indirectly more than 25% of the share capital/voting rights or otherwise exercising control over the SAS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through the INPI Guichet Unique; verified by the greffe and subject to anti-money-laundering supervision by Tracfin
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No independent annual form is prescribed; the RBE must be updated within 30 days of any modification of beneficial ownership, including a transfer of SAS shares that crosses the 25% threshold. As part of each annual accounts cycle the company must verify the registered RBE and file a correction if the shareholding map has changed.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure exposes the legal representative to a fine of up to EUR 7,500 and the legal entity to a fine of up to EUR 37,500; voting rights and economic rights attached to the non-declared holdings may be suspended, and the commercial court may enjoin correction coupled with an astreinte.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory when the SAS exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at year-end: total balance-sheet assets greater than EUR 4,000,000; net turnover (exclusive of tax) greater than EUR 8,000,000; average number of employees greater than 50. An auditor is also required, without the thresholds, where the SAS controls another legal entity subject to audit, where shareholders holding at least one-tenth of the capital request it judicially, or where the articles of incorporation so provide.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory individual (social) accounts must be prepared under French GAAP in accordance with the ANC Regulation No. 2014-03 maintaining the Plan Comptable Général; consolidated financial statements of a group headed by the SAS may, when conditions are met, be prepared under IFRS as adopted by the EU (Regulation (EC) No 1606/2002). Annual accounts must be filed in the single digital XML format required by the INPI Guichet Unique.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: French law does not impose a standalone annual UBO filing; instead there is a continuous updating obligation within 30 days of any change in the identity of beneficial owners or of the nature of their control. Each share transfer must first be registered in the share-transfer register (registre des mouvements de titres) to be validly opposable; the RBE declaration is then compared against the register of members and, if a transfer changes the natural person with more than 25% holding or control, the corrective form is submitted to the INPI Guichet Unique. If no change has occurred, no separate UBO filing is due during the annual accounts cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Share Movements and Corporate Decisions (registre des mouvements de titres et des décisions de l'organe social)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (registre des procès-verbaux d'assemblées)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 320–1,650 per year (approximately EUR 300–1,500 excl. VAT) for a commercial domiciliation address plus annual corporate-secretarial agent retainers in France
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,400–16,200 for a statutory audit of an SME-to-mid-size SAS meeting the mandatory audit thresholds (approximately EUR 5,000–15,000 excl. VAT); simplified voluntary review engagements for sub-threshold entities typically USD 4,300–8,600 per cycle

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% rate on first €42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs; R&D tax credit up to 30% of qualifying expenditures; accelerated depreciation

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065 (Déclaration de résultat) via impots.gouv.fr electronic portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 15th day of the fourth month after fiscal year-end (e.g., 15 April for 31 December year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for French tax residents; non-residents with French permanent establishment report on Form 2075

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claims for R&D credits, apprenticeship tax credit and other incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Limited to French-source income for non-residents; apply treaty benefits where applicable

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 0.75% per month of delay on the tax due (minimum €60, maximum 1.5%); plus interest at the official rate plus 0.2% per month on late payments

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12.8% on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders (0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying EU entities)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: File TRC application with supporting documentation including beneficial ownership certificate; obtain pre-approval to reduce or eliminate WHT at source
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% for EU intra-group or 5-10% under bilateral treaties; Interest: 0% for EU or 10% under OECD model treaties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million annual consolidated turnover for mandatory local file and master file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to qualifying entities in IP holding, finance, or administration sectors; generally not applicable to core transport and logistics operations unless structured as a pure tax haven entity

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional false declaration or concealment of income to evade tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to €5 million or 80% of annual turnover; imprisonment up to 5 years; confiscation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability including imprisonment and fines; disqualification from corporate offices

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Absence of contemporaneous documentation or use of non-arm's length intra-group pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty up to €5 million or 5% of turnover; upward adjustment of taxable base
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for gross negligence; potential criminal charges if fraudulent

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Late or Non-Filing of Tax Returns
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit annual corporate tax return or significant delays
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 0.75% per month of delay on tax due (min €60, max 1.5%); interest on arrears
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: No direct criminal liability but possible civil sanctions and professional disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance or Base Erosion Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing entities without real economic activity solely for tax avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of transactions; fines up to €5 million; criminal prosecution for fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fines for willful misconduct; veil piercing possible
